ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page/URL with price and description
ideas.why: Catalogue renders only names in paragraphs, so individual product pages would give crawlers and AI distinct, quotable content.

ideas.idea: Add more buyer-facing text on the home page (price range, shipping, returns, how to order)
ideas.why: Home.jsx contains a single sentence, so more substantive content would help people and machines understand the offer.
The site has no structured data and sells identifiable products from a named location, so JSON-LD could clarify what it is.

ideas.idea: Declare the site origin and add a canonical tag per page
ideas.why: No canonical or domain is set in index.html, and absolute canonicals help consolidate URLs.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta and Open Graph tags
ideas.why: index.html lacks them, but this is standard head hygiene with modest effect on discoverability.
Routes define only / and /catalogue, so unknown URLs on a static host would return the app shell with 200 (soft 404s).

ideas.idea: Give each route its own title via React 19 <title>/<meta> elements
ideas.why: Per-route titles are sound, but without prerendering client-set tags are not visible to non-JS crawlers; it mostly overlaps the known title issue.

ideas.idea: Link onward to the catalogue from the Home page body
ideas.why: Home.jsx has no link to /catalogue, so a body link adds a crawlable path to the product listing.
